text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, a small mountain of fan letters arrives for Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Are… Are all of these for me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ich bin so glücklich… I mean, I feel so very happy. How I wish I could show this to my parents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I must reply to each and every one.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. Worry not, I will maintain my schedule perfectly even as I pour my heart into my responses.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Flash, you ate really fast today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. I must use my time efficiently so I can—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah! You said you were going to reply to your fan mail. I remember now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "I've been rooting for you since your debut." …Wow! This fan has spectated all of my races thus far.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'm so touched. I must do my utmost to continue being a runner worthy of their support.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Although… simply voicing my thoughts will not do. I must properly convey my gratitude in my written response.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Now Falcon, I'd like you to try using this formula to solve the problem. I'll give you fifteen minutes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In the meantime, please excuse me. I have some reading to do.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: B-but we're in the middle of a study session!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Gasp! This letter is in German. Perhaps it was written by a German who is living in Japan, just like me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Your running brings pride to our country." Hehe. What an honor.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So what I mean is… I'm amazed, Flash! You actually replied to all your letters in a week!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? More?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I fear to ask you this, but could it be the box you're carrying is full of…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: N-no way! Are those all fan letters?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I didn't realize that my racing had caught the attention of so many people…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: This is so cool! I'm so proud of you!
choice_data_list: Are you going to reply to all of these too?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Naturally. It is my duty to respond to their enthusiasm in kind.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Each of the fan letters I received the other day was filled with the writer's warmth and encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I wish with all my heart to convey just how equally grateful I am to them.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ooh! You really are something else! I could learn a thing or two from you as an Umadol!
